title: Summit Plan Underwriting Thresholds — Borrower Age, Appraised Value and Principal Limit
content:
Each plan of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage is written only where the youngest borrower, the home and the size of the loan meet the thresholds of that plan. The figures below are the plan's terms as fixed at closing; ages are whole years of the youngest borrower at closing, and amounts are in US dollars.

## 1. Entry conditions by plan

| Plan | Youngest borrower at least | Home appraised at least | Collateral condition of the plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | 60 | USD 250000.00 | first lien |
| Summit Flex Fixed | 60 | USD 250000.00 | first lien |
| Summit Select Line | 60 | USD 400000.00 | first lien |
| Summit Condo Line | 62 | USD 300000.00 | the home is a condominium |
| Summit Second Lien | 60 | USD 300000.00 | second lien, behind an existing forward first mortgage |
| Summit Estate Line | 62 | USD 2000000.00 | first lien |

## 2. States with their own minimum age

The minimum age is the plan's age above, or the lower age the following state schedule gives for the state in which the property sits.

| Plan | CA | FL | TX |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | 55 | 55 | 62 |
| Summit Flex Fixed | 55 | 55 | 62 |
| Summit Select Line | 55 | 55 | 62 |
| Summit Condo Line | 62 | 62 | 62 |
| Summit Second Lien | 55 | 55 | 62 |
| Summit Estate Line | 62 | 62 | 62 |

## 3. Appraisal and principal limit

| Plan | Appraisals at closing | Principal limit at most, as a percent of appraised value | Principal limit at most, in dollars |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | 1 | 58% | USD 4000000.00 |
| Summit Flex Fixed | 1 | 55% | USD 4000000.00 |
| Summit Select Line | 1 | 52% | USD 4000000.00 |
| Summit Condo Line | 1 | 50% | USD 2500000.00 |
| Summit Second Lien | 1 | 40% | USD 1500000.00 |
| Summit Estate Line | 2 | 50% | USD 4000000.00 |

The initial principal limit must satisfy both ceilings at once: it is at most the percentage of the appraised value shown for the plan, and at most the dollar figure shown for the plan. Each ceiling is inclusive — a principal limit exactly on either figure is within it.

## 4. Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A home appraised, for illustration only, at USD 1215000.00 under the Summit Select Line supports a principal limit of no more than 52% of that value, which is USD 631800.00; the plan's dollar ceiling of USD 4000000.00 is higher, so the percentage ceiling is the one that binds. A principal limit of USD 631800.00 is within the terms; one cent more is not.

## 5. Points of judgement

- **Is the age test about the oldest borrower?** No. It is the youngest borrower's age in whole years at closing.
- **Does a single appraisal satisfy the Summit Estate Line?** No. That plan is closed on 2 appraisals; every other Summit plan on 1.
